title: The open's blood-table move edits with no erase: it rides on the store's erase mark
evidence: Done 2026-11-25 (R5 PR 2): writeMovedRecord (storage/roadmap-store.ts) edits under this.session.eraseIdentity, the erase the open read, as the engine's move does (ios/engine/cloud.ts). It runs synchronously inside RoadmapStore.create, before any page can show another erase, so no refusal can be staged and the answer is the store mark's today; roadmap-store-blood-table.test.ts and local-first-data.test.ts blood_tests_unified still pass. Was: roadmap-store.ts:177 this.session.edit(() => {}) with none R5 PR 3 (2026-11-25): the erase is a required argument by type on every RoadmapStore and lib/roadmap-data.ts writer, on RecordSession.refuses and .edit (packages/health-core/src/record-session.ts: the fallback default `erase = this.shownErase` is gone), and on the web upload Save's state (storage/upload-save-store.ts WebSaving; the phone's door still omits it). A writer that forgets it does not compile: storage/roadmap-store-erase-argument.test.ts `writersRequireAnErase` (one @ts-expect-error per writer) and its table (each writer under an older erase refused, record JSON unchanged; under the shown erase it lands).
